paragraphs.text: Ryan Miller is the former Designer for Duel Masters and Kaijudo at Wizards of the Coast . He worked for the company between January 2000 and April 2013
Miller sometimes contributed to Magic R&D . As a writer, he contributed to Uncharted Realms . He also came up with the Wizard's Tower format.

After leaving Wizards of the Coast, Miller was a freelance game designer, where he worked on multiple games including Top Gun: Plot Twist , Aliens: Bug Hunt and The Princess Bride Adventure Book Game . He went on to work as a designer for Lorcana at Ravensburger.
